finding: An active view that has completed NI5 can release while its peer remains NI5. Full reset converts the linked peer NI4 source proxy and its held destination to NI3 using the active view release duration. They share the new per-view fade; the prior pose span is replaced. First-person-active release immediately zero-deactivates body held and linked proxy.
model_implication: The service currently rejects this case. Pose snapshots must remain representable during held NI3 and retain the requested destination frame until expiry. This bounded release path does not require preserving the old independent NI4 fade lifetime. Current validation requires a pose to be resident NI5, so extend that contract and its frame/projection rules before world wiring.
